name: sql-fs-api
description: Persistent filesystem backend (Postgres) + HTTP/MCP API for just-bash sandboxes
author: Harry Nguyen

scripts.setup:dev: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir clients/typescript install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --project clients/python --locked --extra dev
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm check:scripts && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm check:typescript && pnpm check:python
scripts.check:scripts: bash -n scripts/check-python.sh && bash -n scripts/check-python-types.sh && bash -n scripts/verify-local.sh && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/verify/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:typescript: pnpm --dir clients/typescript typecheck && pnpm --dir clients/typescript test && pnpm --dir clients/typescript build
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-openapi-version.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
